rationale: X independently rediscovers two of the ground truth's blocking issues almost exactly (the --text-encoder-tp-size GroupCoordinator crash and Ring attention silently ignoring packed padding boundaries, both matching hsliuustc0106's inline comments) plus a close match on the encoder weight-loading gap and upload-limit issue, giving it real recall against the human reviewers. Y is meticulously evidenced and finds plausible new bugs (FA4 dead branch, max_seqlen_q document-max bug), but almost none of its findings overlap with what the actual reviewers flagged — it only tangentially brushes the text-encoder-tp-size area via a test-coverage note without identifying the crash itself. Precision and actionability are comparably strong for both (specific file/line citations and concrete fixes), so the recall gap decides it.
